messages.subject: Project Quartz - instruction to act
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Following our call, please take this as formal instruction for Thornbury to acquire the freehold of Quartz House, 14-18 Forbury Road, Reading. Agreed price with the seller (Calderdale Asset Holdings) is £8.45m, multi-let, four tenants. We'd like to target completion in early-to-mid May.

Can you send the engagement letter and get title and searches moving?

Isla

messages.subject: RE: Project Quartz - instruction to act
messages.plaintextBody:
Isla,

Thanks - delighted to act. Engagement letter attached for signature; our reference is WC-00166. Sarah is supervising partner and Elena will assist me day to day.

We'll order the official copies and pre-contract searches today and raise CPSE enquiries once we have the data room. Estimated fees £34k-£42k plus VAT and disbursements (SDLT will be £412,000 on the price).

Best,
James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
